summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper downloads Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is an obfuscated launcher (hex-renamed identifiers, per-function string-key maps) that detects the installer's OS/arch/libc, downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and uses execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a ~728 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with fully obfuscated identifiers, a large mixed number/string constants array, and a rotated string-array function (WV8StW) matching the obfuscator.io shape — the contents are not inspectable by ordinary Node tooling. A React component library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at npm install time to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload; the Bun runtime is used specifically because Node cannot execute Bun-cjs bytecode, evading scanners that examine only dist/*.js. Fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
